title: Irreducible Components of Landau Varieties
exact_target: Encode Feynman-diagram combinatorics in the Landau variety and determine whether it helps decompose the variety into irreducible components.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30006207 (OWR-14299088-009). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

MFO-RIMS Tandem Workshop: Optimization, Theoretical Computer Science and Algebraic Geometry: Convexity and Beyond (2025), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2025/9, pp. 405--450. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: The primary report already proves equality between its elimination construction and the Landau variety (Theorem 3). The catalogue instead recasts the target as completeness and genuine occurrence of candidates. That condensed wording below is retained for traceability; the open primary-source question is the combinatorial encoding and irreducible decomposition stated above.
